narr: An upper level disturbance and the interaction of surface boundaries, along with increasing moisture, led to thunderstorms that developed and moved east across the region during the afternoon. Sufficient atmospheric instability and shear led some of the thunderstorms to produce damaging wind and tornadoes, along with locally heavy rain.
ev: The USGS stream gage along Rocky Branch at Whaley St in Columbia reached flood stage after heavy rain. The intersection of Main and Whaley street became impassable as a result.
lsr: USGS WEBCAM AND STREAM GAGE. ROADWAY FLOODED AT ROCKY BRANCH CREEK AT WHALEY STREET. ROADWAY IMPASSABLE.
